title: The push-up test: how many wall push-ups can you do in a row?
caption: How many wall push-ups can you do in a row? Take the push-up test, then find your level: Wall Push-Up Hold, Wall Push-Up, Incline Push-Up or Kneeling Push-Up. Save this and retest in two weeks.

overlays.text: How many wall push-ups can you do in a row? Try it, then swipe.

scenes.footer: Every push-up loads the wrists. Count only clean reps.

overlays.text: Hands on the wall at chest height. Count clean reps until you stop.

scenes.footer: Do this every day. Move on when the hold feels steady.

overlays.text: Start here. Wall Push-Up Hold. 20 seconds. Lower halfway to the wall and hold still.

scenes.footer: Move on when all 10 feel easy.

overlays.text: Wall Push-Up. 10 reps. Hands on the wall, lower slow, press yourself away.

scenes.footer: Chair against the wall. Move on when all 8 feel easy.

overlays.text: Incline Push-Up. 8 reps. Hands on a sturdy chair, lower your chest, press up.

scenes.footer: You outgrew the wall. Move on when all 8 feel easy.

overlays.text: Kneeling Push-Up. 8 reps. Knees down, body straight, lower your chest, press up.

scenes.footer: Same wall, same count. Write down your number.

overlays.text: Do your level every day. Take the wall test again in two weeks.

scenes.footer: Save this and retest in two weeks.
